verdict.rationale: A same-day live probe confirms Cursor publishes a sectioned llms.txt index at cursor.com/docs/llms.txt, plus cursor.com/llms.txt and llms-full.txt, and every docs page renders as raw markdown at URL + .md, so an agent can be pointed straight at agent-oriented docs. The Origin API ships its own llms.txt/llms-full.txt, and machine-readable OpenAPI specs are live for the Cloud Agents and Origin APIs. Missing for 10: first-party documentation describing or promoting the llms.txt/.md surfaces for agent consumption (the evidence comes mainly from probes, not guidance docs).
